    • due

      public boolean due(float[] vec, boolean onEvents)
      Whether a choice is to be made on this tick, every Tactic.EVERY ticks and, with onEvents, also on a tick where something has just happened that can change which way pays: a hit landed or taken, the opponent swinging (hit or miss), the opponent leaving the ground. A sword comes back in twelve and a half ticks and a fixed half second drifts against that; an exchange is better met with a choice made as it starts (in the options framework, an option ends where its subgoal changes; the review the user passed on on 21 October asked for exactly these interrupts). Counts the tick.
      Parameters:
      vec - the actor's input on this tick
